direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; main uses independent reserved zones with no overlap: rendered scene at least 70% of main, plus fixed callout, station and job tracks; single non-wrapping horizontal rail of 9 equal step targets with aria-current and arrow-key movement; refit tight zones before reducing type; condense or paginate side content inside its reserved zone; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68); emerald/neon #A8F04A primary with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any label under 12px to 12px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; guide line inside rail zone with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main, using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory SVG to at least 70% of main; the side evidence zone currently compresses the scene and callouts at 1366x768.
Keep the second logo placement only in this opening story at native aspect; do not repeat it on later steps.
Raise side-zone body and Source detail labels to 16px/24 and 12px minimum, and link each evidence card bidirectionally to Certificate, Receiving and MAT-ALLOY-A nodes.
Enlarge the scene to 70% and give pre-flight nonce/identity checks and the investigation evidence task separate reserved subzones, headings, statuses and controls.
Raise the small route-health and offline-sample text to 16px body with 12px micro-labels only for headings.
Add a visible 2px neon focus ring to the route select and Run Sample investigation control, with aria-live limited to the investigation result.
Enlarge the scene to 70%; keep the three comparison paths in the side zone without duplicating them as competing scene cards.
Make Select this path at least 36px high and ensure selecting it opens the typed consent form rather than only arming Review recovery option.
Align Certificate 120 and Receiving 80 track ends and keep DOES NOT MATCH fully inside the stage bounds beside the gap.
Refit the scene as a cinematic factory SVG filling 70% of main, with t1-t3 in a reserved job track and CELL-MILL-1/CELL-MILL-2 in a reserved station track.
Preserve 3 PROPOSED as untracked until approval in both zones, but remove the duplicated large t1 card so one task detail is primary.
Enlarge the 1/2/3 task targets to at least 36px and add focus rings plus arrow-key movement between proposed tasks.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 preview distinct from stopped state; on Apply, switch it to red outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text and remove any route through it.
Enlarge the SVG route area to 70% and keep the 24h to 0h capacity preview inside the station track, not as a floating callout.
Raise preview explanatory text to 16px and keep one primary, Apply second shock, in the 56px action bar.
Preserve red exclusively on stopped CELL-MILL-2; remove the red tint from Receiving HOLD so held material uses the Held pattern and marker instead.
Separate pre-flight nonce/identity route health from the investigation evidence task with independent status lines and controls, as on step 2.
Enlarge the scene to 70%, show Split as constrained in the job track, and ensure no feasible route traces through CELL-MILL-2.
Preserve red exclusively on stopped CELL-MILL-2 and keep Split available capacity hatched as constrained with its two-cell requirement at 16px.
Enlarge the factory SVG to 70% and align the 120 versus 80 tracks with the mismatch label inside stage bounds.
Make each Select this path at least 36px and confirm selection opens the typed consent form before any acceptance is recorded.
Keep 3 BLOCKED prior tasks visibly separate from 3 PROPOSED replacements, with the approved revised plan stated once in the action-bar status centre.
Preserve red only on CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE in the station track; enlarge the scene/job/station composition to fill 70% of main.
Reduce duplicated t1 detail between scene and board, keep proposed tasks untracked until approval, and enlarge task number targets to 36px with focus rings.
Refit the dense side zone by pagination inside its reserved zone; do not shrink passphrase guidance or step statuses below 16px body.
Enlarge the three evidence stages to fill the scene zone and keep READY, LOCKED and later SEALED states carried by text and marker, not colour alone.
Add a clear 2px focus ring to the passphrase field and Verify ledger primary, and announce only completion results via aria-live polite.
Remove the extra Complete rail target visual weight so the 9-step horizontal rail remains the single navigation array, with completion shown as status in the guide line.
Keep all three sealed stages equal and static, with no loop or pulse, and retain CELL-MILL-2 offline in the final status sentence.
Condense the retained-evidence side zone to one status sentence per completed check at 16px, preserving the sealed packet summary in the action bar.
